snippet.title: PlayStation - Shin Nippon Pro Wrestling - Toukon Retsuden 2 (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Shin Nippon Pro Wrestling: Toukon Retsuden 2 is a Sports game, developed by Yuke's and published by Tomy Corporation, which was released in Japan in 1996.
